text_block_list.text:
While out by the station on a day off,
I hear a familiar voice.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Operation: Urara's Top-Secret Scheme is officially underwaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see~... Wait, Trainer?!
What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really! Me too!
Except what I'm buying is top-secret for my top-secret scheme!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All righty, time to take off!
See ya laaater!

Haru Urara dashes off in a flash.
Curious about what she's up to, I decide to follow her.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ummm, pretty sure the magazine said it was around here...
As Haru Urara searches around, a street vendor calls out to her...

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Vendor
text_block_list.text: Hey there, little lady. Looking for something?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I'm looking for a shoe store!
Do you know where one is, mister?

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Well, aren't you in luck!
I've got the perfect pair of shoes right here for an Umamusume like you. Take a look.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I don't want regular shoes~!
I'm looking for shoes that'll make me run super-duper fast!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Why, these are the ultimate "run super-duper fast" shoes!
I'll even give you a special discount today, how about it?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I can just barely afford that...!
Will they really, truly make me faster?

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Vendor
text_block_list.text: Of course! With these bad boys, first place is practically guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Really, truly, truly?!
Hmmm, it's pretty pricey, but... okay, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Those speed-boosting shoes were a scam?!
And here he said 1st place was guaranteed~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
My top-secret scheme is ruined~!
I was hoping I'd suddenly become super fast today!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: With super-fast shoes and stuff like that!
choice_data_list: There are no shortcuts besides steady practice.
There are no shortcuts besides steady practice.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Aww. I mean, of course I'll practice a whole bunch too!
I just wanted to get fast right away!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Remember how that reporter praised you the other day?
It made me so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: She praised you because I was running with lots of energy, so if I take 1st place, she'll praise you even more, right?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So I wanted to win 1st place as fast as possible to work hard and surprise you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Taking 1st place would make me happy!
And you getting praised would make me even happier!

Her methods might be totally misguided, but Haru Urara is completely sincere.
As her Trainer, I can't help but be touched by her dedication.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Ehehe♪ I got praised!
All right, then next week I'll definitely find those speedy shoes...
choice_data_list: But I want us to work hard together.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Together?
choice_data_list: Let's figure out how to take 1st place together.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, right. Yeah, totally!
I should've just talked to you from the start, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: All righty! Starting tomorrow, I'm gonna train super hard together with you again, Trainer!

Haru Urara dashes back toward Tracen Academy in high spirits.
Inspired by her feelings, I renew my own determination to help her achieve first place.
